Name: Desolate Land
Effect: When this Pokémon comes out, it automatically starts the effects of Desolate Weather. The effects end when the Pokémon leaves the battle. (In case of stalemate, The Pokémon with highest Will might keep the dominant weather). Unique Ability.
Description: The heat is unbearable. Your skin gets red and blistered. All water evaporates, and every step of this Pokémon makes the ground become molten lava.
